name: vibegrid-social-media
description: Full-stack modern social media platform built with React, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL

scripts.sync:all: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('Ai-Learning/Social_Media_Project')){ const cp=require('child_process'); cp.execSync('rsync -a --delete Ai-Learning/Social_Media_Project/client/src/ client/src/ && rsync -a --delete Ai-Learning/Social_Media_Project/client/public/ client/public/ && rsync -a --delete Ai-Learning/Social_Media_Project/server/src/ server/src/'); }"
scripts.build: npm run sync:all && cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
